policies.assembled: a built bike rolls on, no booking
policies.reservation: a built bike with a booked (sometimes paid) space
policies.mixed: depends on the train or route; see conditions

operators.conditions: Built or folded bike; Grande Vitesse (OUIGO) bagged only.
operators.excerpt: Le vélo non démonté n'est pas accepté dans les OUIGO Grande Vitesse. En OUIGO Train Classique, deux possibilités : démonté sous housse à 5 €, ou non démonté à 10 € par voyageur et par trajet, le vélo doit être placé dans les emplacements dédiés.
operators.note: Grande Vitesse bagged-only agrees, but on Train Classique a built bike is a paid 10 euro 'option vélo' added at booking or up to 30 minutes before departure, not free without booking, and it is refused on Paris-Bordeaux and from Friday to Monday on Paris-Bruxelles.

operators.conditions: Free; a free mandatory reservation on certain busy and cross-border lines.
operators.excerpt: Actuellement, aucune réservation n'est requise pour transporter un vélo à bord des TER. Ce dispositif est susceptible d'évoluer. [...] L'emport de votre vélo est gratuit. La réservation est obligatoire selon les périodes et sur certaines lignes. [...] sur certaines lignes vers la Belgique L'emport de votre vélo est payant au prix de 5€
operators.note: Free carriage and the seasonal mandatory reservation on certain lines agree, but the page says no reservation is required at all at present (the 2026 season ended 1 November), and on the cross-border lines to Belgium the bike is paid at 5 euros rather than a free reservation.

operators.conditions: Paid reservation, 10 euros a bike a journey; folded or in a cover free as hand luggage.
operators.excerpt: La réservation d'une place pour votre vélo est obligatoire lors de l'achat au moment de la réservation de votre billet de train. [...] Le tarif par vélo est de 10 €/trajet. [...] Votre vélo plié, peut voyager avec vous en tant que bagage
operators.note: Only certain TGV INOUI sets have bike spaces; a folded or dismantled bike in a labelled cover up to 90 x 130 x 50 cm travels free as luggage; page dated 3 November 2026.

operators.conditions: TER free, first come first served. Nomad to and from Paris: mandatory bike reservation all year; May to August also Caen-Granville-Rennes and Caen-Le Mans-Tours.
operators.excerpt: La réservation vélo est obligatoire tous les jours sur les trains Nomad Résa Paris <> Normandie. [...] L'accès à bord sur les trains du réseau Nomad SAUF sur les trains Nomad Résa Paris <> Normandie reste autorisé, gratuit et sans réservation dans la limite des places disponibles.
operators.note: Free first-come carriage and the year-round mandatory (free) reservation on the Paris lines agree, but the page says nothing about a May to August reservation on Caen-Granville-Rennes or Caen-Le Mans-Tours; the SNCF Voyageurs page (item 5 URL) states the general TER rule as 'votre vélo voyage gratuitement ... souvent sans réservation' with regional exceptions.

operators.conditions: Dedicated bike space reserved with the ticket, 5 to 10 euros; folded or in a cover under 130 x 90 cm free.
operators.excerpt: La réservation de cet espace est obligatoire et doit être faite en même temps que l'achat du billet. Le coût est de 10€ par vélo et par trajet sur les INTERCITÉS de jour (...) ou sur les INTERCITÉS de nuit (...). Sur les INTERCITÉS des lignes Toulouse-Hendaye, Nantes-Lyon, Nantes-Bordeaux et Nancy-Lyon, le coût est de 5€
operators.note: Clermont-Ferrand-Béziers is free without reservation; a folded or bagged bike up to 130 x 90 cm needs no reserved place; page updated 9 November 2026.

operators.trains: London-Brussels, London-Lille (built, booked); London-Paris, Amsterdam, Rotterdam (bagged); EST 9xxx continental (bagged)
operators.conditions: By route: London-Brussels and London-Lille built with a booked space; London-Paris, Amsterdam and Rotterdam bagged only; former Thalys trains folded or bagged only.
operators.excerpt: We can only transport fully assembled bikes on trains travelling between London and Brussels, and London and Amsterdam. If you're travelling between London and Paris, your bike must be disassembled and in a box or bag [...] At the moment, our bike and luggage service is unavailable to/from Lille or Rotterdam.
operators.note: Disagrees on two routes: London-Lille has no bike service at all (only a folding bike under 85 cm in a bag), and London-Amsterdam now takes a fully assembled bike on selected trains rather than bagged only; London-Paris bagged only, Rotterdam no service, and continental trains (both wheels off, non-rigid cover 135 x 85 x 30 cm, 30 euros) agree.

operators.conditions: Bike supplement 3 euros off peak or 5 euros at weekday peaks; no space to reserve; folded free.
operators.excerpt: Only €3 per single journey during off-peak hours, on weekends or public holidays (you do not need Train+ for this) €5 per single journey during peak hours Folding bicycle? These always travel free of charge!
operators.note: The page defines no peak hours and offers no reservation product (spaces are 'limited' and the supplement cannot be bought in the BikeOnTrain planner), so 'no space to reserve' is implied rather than stated.

operators.conditions: Off peak only: weekdays 09:00-16:00 and 18:30-06:30, all day at weekends, holidays, July and August, with a Fietskaart Dal; folded free at all hours.
operators.excerpt: Doordeweeks mag je fiets mee in de daluren: van 9.00 tot 16.00 uur van 18.30 tot 6.30 uur In het weekend, op feestdagen (behalve Koningsdag) en in juli en augustus mag je fiets de hele dag mee. [...] Je hebt altijd een Fietskaart Dal nodig naast je eigen vervoerbewijs.
operators.note: King's Day is excluded from the all-day rule; the Fietskaart Dal costs 8.50 euros; a fully folded folding bike under 45 x 86 x 80 cm travels free all day.

operators.conditions: Bike ticket, subject to space, outside the peak.
operators.excerpt: It is not possible to reserve bicycle spaces on Eurocity Direct trains. Please note! Bicycle tickets do not guarantee a space on the train. [...] If these are occupied, your bicycle will not be transported and you will have to wait for the next similar type of train
operators.note: An international bicycle ticket is required and space is not guaranteed (twelve spaces per train), but the page only advises travelling off peak (09.00-16.00 and 18.30-06.30) rather than barring the peak.

operators.conditions: Free, off peak only.
operators.excerpt: Bicycles can only be taken onto the metro outside peak hours. [...] Bicycles are permitted onto metro lines A, B, C, D and E: Mondays to Fridays 9am – 4pm and after 6.30pm Saturdays and Sundays, throughout the day
operators.note: The page names no bicycle fare, so free is implied rather than stated; bikes are often barred during large events, at most two per spot, and a folded folding bike goes at any time.

operators.conditions: Long-distance bicycle ticket and a reserved space, on selected ICE only, nothing sold on board; folded free. ICE 10-19 have no bike spaces.
operators.excerpt: Fahrradmitnahme ist auf ausgewählten Verbindungen im ICE sowie in allen IC- und EC-Zügen möglich, sofern vorab reserviert. [...] Denn die Mitnahme eines Fahrrads ist im Fernverkehr reservierungspflichtig. [...] Im Zug können Sie kein Fahrradticket kaufen.
operators.note: Folding bikes travel free as hand luggage with no ticket or reservation; the page does not name which ICE sets lack spaces, so the ICE 10-19 (Brussels ICE 3) exclusion is not stated here, only that the booking shows a bike option solely where spaces exist.

operators.conditions: Dedicated bike spaces; reservation and bike ticket mandatory.
operators.excerpt: a bike space reservation costs 4.90 euros, 6.90 euros or 9.90 euros if booked online at least 3 hours before departure. [...] on trains with high passenger volumes, the crew may refuse to take bicycles on board without prior reservation of a bike space for safety reasons.
operators.note: A paid bike ticket is always needed, but the reservation is not stated as mandatory: 16 of 18 spaces are reservable, a last-minute ticket (under 3 hours, or bought on the train) carries a 5.10 euro surcharge, and the Beförderungsbedingungen of 7 April 2026 (clause 13.1) require a reservation only 'um einen garantierten Fahrradabstellplatz zu erhalten'.

operators.conditions: Bike day pass CHF 15. IC: CHF 2 reservation daily 21 March to 31 October on IC2, IC21, IC5, IC51 and Friday to Sunday on other IC lines, CHF 10 surcharge without. IR: no reservation, first come first served.
operators.excerpt: From 21 March to 31 October you will need a bike space reservation for your bike or e-bike on InterCity (IC) trains. [...] Every day for the IC2/21 lines [...] Every day for the IC5/51 lines [...] From Friday to Sunday [...] for all other InterCity lines. [...] A bike space reservation costs CHF 2
operators.note: Page also states the CHF 10 surcharge without a reservation and the Bike Day Pass at CHF 15 (CHF 16 from 13 Dec 2026), adds reservation days on Maundy Thursday, Easter Monday, Ascension and 1 August, and lists compulsory reservation only for IC, EC, ICE and RJX, so InterRegio first come first served is implied rather than stated.

operators.conditions: On trains marked with a bicycle only, one per traveller; free inside Milan, 3 to 3.50 euro supplement beyond; never on a replacement bus.
operators.excerpt: Il trasporto delle biciclette non pieghevoli sui treni Trenord è consentito su corse e linee specifiche. [...] È consentito il trasporto di una sola bicicletta per viaggiatore [...] Sui bus sostitutivi è ammesso il trasporto di bici pieghevoli [...]; non è ammesso il trasporto di biciclette tradizionali.
operators.note: Free carriage applies to all journeys within the Lombardy fare boundaries, not only Milan, and the supplement is called obligatory for supra-regional or cross-border routes without a price on the live page.

operators.conditions: IC: bike slot booked in advance, 3.50 euros, carriage 3, six per train. ICN: no assembled bike, folded or wheels off in a closed bag only.
operators.excerpt: Ogni viaggiatore può trasportare con sé una sola bicicletta, con prenotazione obbligatoria, a un prezzo di 3.50 €. [...] nella carrozza n° 3 sono presenti 6 posti bici [...] Il trasporto della bicicletta montata non è mai consentito sui treni [...] Frecciarossa, Frecciargento, Frecciabianca e Intercity Notte.
operators.note: Bike service is free for purchases 1 to 30 November 2026 with the reservation still compulsory; a folded or dismantled bike in a bag must not exceed 80x110x45 cm.

operators.conditions: Folded or dismantled in a bag only.
operators.excerpt: Il trasporto della bicicletta montata non è mai consentito sui treni di media e lunga percorrenza [...] Frecciarossa, Frecciargento, Frecciabianca e Intercity Notte. [...] Puoi portare gratuitamente una sola bicicletta [...] smontata e contenuta in una sacca o una bici pieghevole opportunamente chiusa
operators.note: Bag limit 80x110x45 cm, one bike per traveller, free.

operators.conditions: Folded or bagged only.
operators.excerpt: Traveling on Italo trains with strollers, folding bicycles, and scooters (both electric and manual) is permitted, as long as they are fully folded and stored in the designated areas. [...] Transporting oversized luggage, bulky items, or traditional bicycles is not allowed.
operators.note: The page allows folding bikes only and merely recommends a carrying bag; a dismantled non-folding bike in a bag is not mentioned as permitted, so the 'bagged' half of our rule is unsupported.

operators.conditions: Bicycle ticket (about 10% of the fare, 2 euros at least) and a bike space reservation (3 euros online), strictly required; Micotra reservation free with the bike ticket.
operators.excerpt: The bicycle ticket costs around 10 % of the standard fare for 2nd class, and no less than € 1.40. [...] For long-distance travel, a mandatory reservation is also required (€3 online, €3.50 at a ticket counter). [...] Bicycle transport on Nightjet services is also possible on selected routes with a bicycle ticket and reservation.
operators.note: Minimum bike ticket is EUR 1.40, not EUR 2, and D trains are not named; the Micotra rule is confirmed on oebb.at/de/regionale-angebote/kaernten/rail-and-bike: a free bicycle reservation is compulsory.

operators.conditions: Flat-rate bike ticket PLN 11.90, only on trains with a bike area or hooks marked in the timetable; never in a WARS sleeper or couchette; EIP sells no bike tickets aboard.
operators.excerpt: Opłata za taki bilet jest zryczałtowana i wynosi 11,90 zł, niezależnie od długości trasy. [...] Przewóz rowerów jest możliwy tylko w pociągach, w których wyznaczono miejsca do ich przewozu. [...] Gdzie nie powinien stać rower? [...] w wagonach gastronomicznych, z miejscami sypialnymi i z miejscami do leżenia (tzw. kuszetki).
operators.note: Page names no train categories or WARS and has no EIP-specific rule: an unticketed bike must be declared to the conductor before boarding (20 zł on-board fee); the Regulamin ties the bike ticket to a seat reservation or EIP supplement and a free bike place.

operators.trains: D62, D10 and the regional network
operators.conditions: One bike per traveller.
operators.excerpt: § 22. Przewóz rowerów i hulajnóg 1. Podróżny może przewieźć odpłatnie jeden rozłożony rower albo jedną rozłożoną hulajnogę w stanie umożliwiającym jej poruszanie.
operators.note: Carriage is paid (fee in the Cennik), places may be limited and in the dedicated bike wagons on selected trains a reservation is required (§ 23a-d); D62 and D10 are not named.

operators.conditions: InterCity: bicycle ticket and mandatory space reservation. Stopping trains: no reservation, bar trains marked with the prohibition symbol.
operators.excerpt: Bizonyos vonatokon (jellemzően InterCity és expresszvonaton) a kerékpárjegy mellé kerékpárhelyjegyet is szükséges váltani. [...] 2-2 darab kerékpár szállítható a menetrendben a fenti piktogramokkal nem jelölt vonatokon is [...] a vonat első vagy utolsó feljáróajtóval rendelkező másodosztályú peronján.
operators.note: Prohibition pictogram is defined as 'Kerékpár nem szállítható'; unmarked trains take 2 bikes per end platform; kerékpárhelyjegy costs 100, 300, 650 or 990 Ft; the G and Z categories are not named.

operators.conditions: Entrance platform of the last coach, looked after by its rider, BGN 3 fee with the ticket, no reservation.
operators.excerpt: On the entrance platform of the last coach in the composition of all fast and passenger trains or in the luggage zone in electric multiple units. [...] The passengers take care of their own bicycles during journey time. [...] The bicycle transportation fee amounts to BGN 3.00 (1.53 EUR) and is payable upon the purchase of a ticket
operators.note: Page dated 27.01.2020; the Bulgarian version bans bikes in sleeper and couchette cars, charges 20 BGN for an unticketed bike and refuses bikes on replacement buses; no reservation is mentioned.

operators.conditions: On domestic trains and the designated cross-border and international ones.
operators.excerpt: Bicikli se mogu prevoziti u unutarnjem i pograničnom prometu [...] Bicikl se može prevesti: u svim vlakovima kao osobna prtljaga [...] u određenim vlakovima koji u sastavu imaju vagon s prostorom za smještaj bicikala (10 bicikala) ili prostor za smještaj bicikla. Jednosmjerna karta za prijevoz bicikla iznosi 1,99 EUR
operators.note: A built bike goes only on the trains the page lists (updated 20.11.2026), a folded one as luggage on any train, EUR 1.99 one way; the cross-border and international trains are listed on hzpp.hr/en/international/bicycle-transport.

operators.trains: YHT; Marmaray, Başkentray, İzban; mainline and regional
operators.conditions: YHT: only fully packed in a zipped bag, front wheel off. Marmaray, Başkentray, İzban: free bar Sundays, holidays and weekday peaks. Mainline and regional: generally restricted unless the train has a luggage car or hooks; pack it.
operators.note: Not verified: the official rules page loads its Bisiklet Taşımaları section from an authenticated API, and marmaray.gov.tr has an expired TLS certificate; search snippets of marmaray.gov.tr give peak hours 07:00-08:30 and 16:00-19:30 rather than 07:00-09:00 and 16:00-20:00, and describe YHT as folding bikes only, so the rule needs checking in a browser.

operators.conditions: Free on every train.
operators.excerpt: Puede viajar con su bicicleta, gratuitamente, en todos nuestros trenes.
operators.note: The web page names no restriction, but Euskotren's Condiciones Generales PDF (art. 10) says free access on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays all day but on weekdays only 10:00-12:30 and from 19:00 to end of service, one bike per passenger, and access may be refused at busy times; the site blocks non-browser fetches (403).

operators.conditions: Full-size bikes on board, no reservation, typically three per train.
operators.excerpt: You can travel with your bike without folding or disassembling it on all our trains [...] free of charge and without the need for booking in advance.
operators.note: The table lists MD without reservation and metre-gauge MD as free with no add-on, but MD with reservation (and Avant) needs the free 'Tren+bici' add-on; the page gives no per-train count, only 'the availability of spaces on the train is limited' and a 200 cm maximum length.

operators.conditions: No full-size assembled bicycle; folded or disassembled in a cover only.
operators.excerpt: it is not possible to travel with bicycles that have not been disassembly, so they must be folded or disassembled.
operators.note: Alvia, Intercity and Euromed are each marked 'Not allowed' for a full-size bike; a folded bike (sum of sides 180 cm) needs no add-on, a disassembled one needs the free bicycle add-on and a case of 140 x 90 x 40 cm.

operators.conditions: Bagged or folded only.
operators.excerpt: no es posible viajar con bicicletas completas, debiendo viajar plegadas o desmontadas.
operators.note: On AVE a folded bike is free and a disassembled one needs the free bicycle add-on; on Avlo both folded and disassembled bikes are charged as 'Extra de equipaje adicional'.

operators.conditions: Built bike with a reservation, three per train, or disassembled and packed.
operators.excerpt: Transport is subject to prior reservation of the space at the time of ticket purchase. [...] Carried as hand luggage, with maximum dimensions of 120 x 90 x 40 cm.
operators.note: No renfe.com page states a Celta bike rule, so this is co-operator CP's page; CP's Celta page (cp.pt/info/en/train-celta-porto-vigo) says 'space for 2 bicycles or scooters, subject to prior reservation', two spaces rather than three, with a packed bike as hand luggage up to 120 x 90 x 40 cm.

operators.conditions: Only completely disassembled and packed as hand luggage.
operators.excerpt: On the Alfa Pendular, bicycles and scooters can be transported as long as they are disassembled and properly packed as luggage that does not exceed, in the luggage racks or under the seats, the space corresponding to the seats to which they are entitled, up to a maximum of one per passenger.
operators.note: Intercidades does carry a built bike with a reservation: cp.pt/info/en/w/bikes-and-scooters says bicycles up to 15 kg can be carried on the carrier hooks by booking seats 15 or 17 (Lisbon-Braga and other northern routes) or 12 and 18 (Lisbon-Guarda, Evora, Faro) in 2nd class, free; bikes over 15 kg only folded or disassembled as hand luggage.

operators.conditions: A standard bike on board, subject to space and the crew, no reservation.
operators.excerpt: Ombordpersonalen har ansvaret för säkerheten ombord. De bestämmer om din cykel kan tas med. Bedömningen görs alltid utifrån utrymme och säkerhet. Det innebär att det aldrig finns en garanterad plats för cykeln.
operators.note: At most six bikes per set on Pågatåg and Öresundståg, one standard bike per rider, free within Skåne, a cykeltillägg over the Öresund bridge; oresundstag.se adds that space cannot be reserved; the weekday rush-hour ban due 1 Nov 2026 was revoked on 23 Oct 2026, though some restriction is still to come.

operators.trains: NT day and night trains; mountain trains 24 and 25
operators.conditions: No bike at all, folded only within hand-luggage size (55 x 45 x 25 cm); built with a booked space on the summer and autumn mountain trains only, 199 SEK a direction.
operators.excerpt: Cykel får medföras ombord på våra fjälltåg som går på sommaren och hösten (tåg 24 och 25) [...] Förboka cykeltransport i resgodsvagnen för 199 kr per riktning [...] Av utrymmesskäl är det inte tillåtet att ta med cykel ombord på våra andra tåg. Hopfällda cyklar får dock medfölja om de ryms inom måtten för handbagage (max 55x45x25 cm).
operators.note: The bike travels checked into the luggage van and must be packed against damage; newer Snälltåget pages number the mountain trains 3920/3921, and a connecting transfer takes the bike for 125 kr a direction.

operators.conditions: Bicycle ticket with a mandatory space reservation. EuroCity: international bicycle ticket and mandatory reservation, eight to twelve spaces a train, booked by phone, desk or DB.
operators.excerpt: Hvis du skal have din cykel med på et InterCity (IC), InterCityLyn (ICL), Lyn+ eller regional (RE) tog [...] skal du købe en Cykelpladsbillet til din cykel. [...] Cykelpladsbilletten dækker både selve billetten og reservation af selve pladsen.
operators.note: Domestic rule confirmed (dsb.dk/en: a Cycle Space Ticket costing 20 DKK on InterCity trains), but no live DSB page states the EuroCity Hamburg rules: the old international bicycle ticket page redirects to a general page, so eight to twelve spaces, one per person and phone/desk/DB booking could not be verified from dsb.dk.

operators.trains: SJ Sweden; SJ Nord Dovre and Nordland lines
operators.conditions: SJ Sweden: no built bike, dismantled in a bag within 140 x 85 x 30 cm. SJ Norge: bicycle ticket booked ahead on the Dovre and Nordland lines, first come locally, 175 cm at most, barred from a replacement bus.
operators.excerpt: Bicycles are to be disassembled or folded and stored in a bicycle bag before embarking (maximum dimensions 140x85x30 cm, maximum weight 25 kg including bicycle and bag). The bag must be placed in the luggage compartment.
operators.note: SJ Norge confirmed at sj.no/en/plan-your-journey/lugagge/bicycles/: bicycle add-on pre-booked on the Dovre (Oslo-Trondheim) and Nordland (Trondheim-Bodø) lines, elsewhere turn up and board if there is room with the conductor deciding, maximum 175 cm, not allowed when part of the journey is a planned replacement bus, price 50% of a Standard Refundable adult fare (min NOK 50, max NOK 250).

operators.conditions: Separate bicycle ticket, 45% surcharge, one per passenger, never in first class, 185 x 110 x 60 cm and 25 kg at most; packed within a 200 cm sum free.
operators.excerpt: In 2nd-class cars, a 45% surcharge applies, calculated based on the full ticket price for a 2nd-class train. [...] In 1st-class cars, bicycles cannot be transported. [...] The bicycle must not exceed 185 x 110 x 60 cm (length, height, width), and its weight must not exceed 25 kg
operators.note: One bicycle per passenger; a disassembled, packed bike whose three dimensions sum to no more than 200 cm and under 25 kg travels free.

operators.trains: Bergen line, Flåm railway, Oslo-Gothenburg (booked); other regional and local (open)
operators.conditions: Reservation required on the Bergen line, the Flåm railway and Oslo-Gothenburg-Malmö, advised on the Gjøvik line and Oslo-Halden-Gothenburg; none on other trains, boarding the cars marked with a bicycle.
operators.excerpt: On the Bergen Line and the Flåm Railway you must reserve a bicycle space in advance. [...] On the Gjøvik Line and Oslo S–Halden–Gothenburg we recommend that you reserve a bicycle space. [...] You do not have to reserve a bicycle space on other trains.
operators.note: The page lists no Oslo-Gothenburg-Malmö service with a required reservation; Oslo S-Halden-Gothenburg is recommended only; on other trains take the bike to a carriage marked with a bicycle and buy a bicycle ticket on board, maximum 175 cm, folding bikes free as carry-on, Flåm reservations only in summer.

operators.trains: All trains with both ends in Great Britain
operators.conditions: A built bike is carried by every operator; a booked space on long-distance services.
operators.excerpt: On some trains, you need to reserve a space for your bike before you travel. [...] Make sure you check the specific cycle policies for each train company you travel with.
operators.note: National Rail defers to the per-operator list at nationalrail.co.uk/on-the-train/train-travel-with-bicycles/cycle-policies/ (29 operators); the National Rail Conditions of Travel (July 2026) say non-folding cycles are allowed on most services but restrictions may apply by time or day, a charge may be made and a reservation may be required.
